slides.heading: How much range does AC eat in an EV?
Use the AC. Just use it smart.

voice_lines: In Indian heat, the AC usually takes about ten to twenty percent of an EV's range.
City traffic feels it most, because the AC keeps running while the car barely moves.
Pre-cool the cabin while it's plugged in, switch to recirculation once it's cool, and park in shade.
So use the AC, just use it smartly. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
How much range does the AC take in an EV? ❄️

Usually about 10-20% in Indian heat (approximate, depends on car, temperature and traffic). City crawling feels it most.

Get some back:
• Pre-cool while plugged in
• Recirculation once the cabin is cool
• Park in shade
• Eco AC mode if your car has it

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
